title: Adversarial review of Story 1.2 safe convergence and recovery
summary: Adversarially review the implemented Story 1.2 transaction core against its frozen contract: deterministic planning, adoption/update safety, TOCTOU and stale-plan protection, immutable approval binding, locking, recovery journals and backups, rollback and interruption recovery, applied-revision atomicity, idempotence, and secret-safe mutation evidence.
